text:
# filter.expiresAtBefore

TL;DR:
- filter.expiresAtBefore matches listings expiring before a given timestamp.

What it means:
- It adds an upper expiration-time bound to the query.

Agent hint:
- Use it for time-sensitive browsing such as items expiring soon.
